review.scanner: Flat teal ceramic contactless scanner within bronze plate on fixed stone jamb; no shaped socket or insertion. Clear air gap.
review.credential: Ivory top grip held overhand, asymmetrical C/horseshoe metal body hangs down with red indicator, scale consistent with ta013 relative to child hand.
review.anatomy: Four curled finger forms; opposing thumb normally hidden under overhand grip. No obvious extra digits.
review.identity: Taffy broad torso, cheeks, large rounded ears, cheek lines and costume preserved; Harper retained in medium shot, excluded by close crop.
caveats: Scanner bronze mounting trim and bottom fasteners vary slightly between wide and close; teal face and amber indicator stay consistent.
These are starter stills, not proof of completed waving motion or scanner response.
